recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It resolves the current semantic contradiction between the old absolute narrative and active case-insensitive color CodeSystems while preserving the FHIR-5572 default rule.
issue_request: FHIR-5572 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core issue asking the terminology pages to say that FHIR code systems, like v2 and v3 code systems, are case sensitive. Jira comments recorded the accepted application as a validation rule requiring FHIR-defined code systems to declare caseSensitive=true and narrative saying FHIR-defined codes are case sensitive.
initial_application: The current terminology narrative already carried the original rule, saying that all codes defined by FHIR itself are case sensitive and SHALL be used in the provided case. Git history shows this rule was carried forward in source/terminologies.html after the early SVN-era application; the companion FHIR-5571 case-sensitivity cleanup is already represented on the combined branch.
additional_context: The current build now has active FHIR-hosted color CodeSystems listed in source/fhir.ini with caseSensitive=false, added later for DeviceMetric color work. Those CodeSystems explicitly say CSS color names and RGB codes are case-insensitive. Later DeviceMetric issues make clear these color terminology resources are intentional current-build content, even though further R6 work may move them to THO. Community search did not find a FHIR-5572-specific contradiction, but related Zulip discussion supports using the underlying CodeSystem semantics for case sensitivity.
reconciliation: Updated source/terminologies.html so the terminology overview still preserves the FHIR-5572 default case-sensitive rule, while recognizing that a FHIR-defined CodeSystem can explicitly declare otherwise. No CodeSystem definitions were changed.
source_changes: source/terminologies.html: clarified that FHIR-defined CodeSystems declare case sensitivity and default to case-sensitive codes unless explicitly stated otherwise.

related_jiras.note: Companion DSTU1 issue requiring specific questionnaire text type code systems to be case sensitive; already audited on the combined branch.
DeviceMetric color binding work introduced the current color terminology family that includes explicit case-insensitive CodeSystems.
Later Applied DeviceMetric.color decision confirms the color value set remains active current-build terminology context.
Resolved-change-required DeviceMetric color discussion may move color resources to THO, but it is outside this FHIR-5572 reconciliation.
